Mydei had to stare at that man, now remembering what exactly had set Phainon off -  those conversations of breaking up and getting out of each other’s lives.

.. That secret little word. 

Mydei found himself staring at Phainon even more over that - one of his eyebrows raising a little as he thought about it; “.. Was the word ‘divorce’?”

Mydei barely even finished those words before a pair of lips were on his own with a hand burrowing into his hair on the back of his head - forcing him deeper into that kiss as he gasped a little at how sudden it was. The worst part was how Mydei didn’t even feel like attempting to pull away - instead allowing that man to keep him nice and close.

Instead, he found himself fully kissing Phainon back - just as hungrily as he felt that man’s tongue slip into his mouth without any hesitation. Mydei always let his husband kiss him like that, after all, he always enjoyed it just as much as the other man as he closed his eyes and felt that tongue rubbing into his own mouth.

Seemingly taking its time to press on Mydei’s tongue, flicking across his piercing there before Phainon harshly broke away - barely pulling back any before panting out a heavy breath. One that made Mydei blink his eyes that had barely just closed at the man slowly open once more. 

“Forget that word, okay, beautiful?” Phainon chuckled a little as he spoke - sounding more than a little stressed as he smiled at Mydei very sweetly, “It doesn’t exist for us.”

Mydei stared at that man, just for a brief moment before running his tongue against the back of his own teeth. He desperately wanted another kiss from that man, especially as that hand on the back of his head only gently seemed to pet his hair soothingly. 

Yet, Mydei sighed a little;  “.. Alright.”

“Good boy, here..” Phainon’s hand left Mydei’s head at that, instead moving to one of those plates as he leaned away a little; “A treat for you.”

Mydei had to blink over that - watching as Phainon turned back to him on the bed with such a happy look on his face. 

“Your favorite chocolates, I had them specially made for you last night but ah..” Phainon hummed, not even hesitating as he borderline pressed the chocolate to Mydei’s lips - and well, Mydei had never needed much convincing to eat sweets. Instead willingly opening his mouth for it and letting that man practically rub his fingers against Mydei’s tongue as he pushed the chocolate in,  “We were a bit distracted!”

Mydei hummed over that, a bit sated over the way that chocolate did easily melt on his tongue - a sweet little treat of richness that he was so painfully fond of.

Though, he couldn’t help but tilt his head a little to the side - still studying how odd his husband had been today, and he didn’t just mean the tracker.

No, he was antsy and seeming unsettled - he had something to say, but he wasn’t. And that only irked Mydei more. 

“Are you hiding something, Phainon?” Mydei asked as he tried to swallow down that chocolate - narrowing his gaze over the way his husband was acting so painfully cute. His head tilting to the side with such wide, innocent eyes, as if he could understand why he was even being questioned about such a thing!

“Hmm? Of course not?” Phainon so painfully sweetly spoke, as if he was trying to drench every single word out of his own mouth with a coat of honey.

An attempt that only made Mydei chuckle a little; “Is that so? And if I say I want a divorce, what will you do to me?”

The effect of that was instant as the smile on Phainon’s lips faltered so painfully quickly - instead completely taken over by an expression of worry and dread, “M.. Mydei, please.. You said that you would forget that word.”

“Would you chain me up and keep me all to yourself?” Mydei asked, all while grabbing that man rather roughly - basking in the way his husband put up little to no resistance. Instead, Phainon seemed a little bit eager as he let Mydei fully yank him down - forcing him onto his back on their bed with a little huff leaving Phainon’s lips over the roughness, but no complaints. 

Not a single complaint, even as Mydei moved to fully push that man to the bed, throwing his legs over the sides of Phainon to straddle him down. Not caring at all over how heavy he probably was on the man as he instead moved a hand to sweetly caress Phainon’s cheek - soothingly petting his partner with a little chuckle leaving his lips as he leaned down a little.

Just enough to be a mere hair away from kissing that man again, “I want to see that. Won’t you reassure me and show me how much you love me?”

“Mydeimos..” Phainon’s voice was barely an echo of its normal volume, making Mydei’s hand move to brush white locks of hair back gently - exposing more of his face before placing a chaste kiss against Phainon’s rather hot to the touch forehead, “If a chain is all it takes to make sure you don’t leave me, I’ll get it out of the spare closet..”

Mydei couldn’t help the quiet laugh that bubbled out of him as he pulled away from Phainon just a little - enough to make his own hair curtain around both of their heads as he put their foreheads together to look into those vivid blue eyes. Taking in the way they seemed so innocent and endearing, all while saying the most insane and heinous things to his own husband. And somehow, they were all things that Mydei found himself enjoying being told. 

“You already had one waiting? Naughty puppy.”

“Woof woof.”
